Grumpig

Psychic

Hoenn · Generation 3

Grumpig is a Psychic-type Manipulate Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 71.5 kg. It evolves from Spoink. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (110), with a base stat total of 470.
